name: Adaptive Technical Project Risk Management
description: A comprehensive practice integrating systems-theoretic risk analysis (STAMP/STPA), resilience engineering, and adaptive governance to transition from reactive, component-level risk mitigation to adaptive, systems-theoretic frameworks in complex technical environments.

alphas.name: Systemic Risk Profile
alphas.description: The holistic state of technical risk viewed as a dynamic control problem rather than a linear component failure issue.

states.name: Contextualized
states.description: The operational context of the software system is understood using complexity and systems theory.

checklist.name: Cynefin Domain Assessed
checklist.description: The system portfolio is mapped across the Clear, Complicated, Complex, Chaotic, and Disorder domains to calibrate the risk management approach.

checklist.name: Cliff Boundary Identified
checklist.description: The dangerous boundary between the Clear and Chaotic domains is monitored to prevent catastrophic collapse from rigid constraints.

checklist.name: Internal Dynamics Mapped
checklist.description: Causal Loop Diagrams (CLDs) are explicitly created to map non-linear feedback mechanisms, differentiating between reinforcing and balancing loops.

states.name: Modeled
states.description: The system is proactively modeled as a hierarchical control-feedback loop using STPA.

checklist.name: Unacceptable Losses Defined
checklist.description: System losses, such as loss of revenue, brand trust, injury, or legal compliance, are explicitly defined.

checklist.name: Control Structure Built
checklist.description: A Hierarchical Control Structure (HCS) model detailing controllers, actuators, processes, and feedback sensors is constructed.

checklist.name: Unsafe Actions Identified
checklist.description: Unsafe Control Actions (UCAs) are rigorously identified to catch unknown unknowns and critical design flaws.

states.name: Mitigated In Delivery
states.description: Risk management is democratized and embedded directly into standard Agile delivery lifecycles and CI/CD pipelines.

checklist.name: Sprint Inception Evaluated
checklist.description: Risk is meticulously evaluated at the inception of the cycle during Sprint Planning, with mitigation tasks added directly to the sprint backlog.

checklist.name: Latent Risks Scanned
checklist.description: Daily standups are utilized to actively scan for and differentiate between immediate impediments and latent risks.

checklist.name: Release Gates Enforced
checklist.description: Automated quality and security checks act as non-negotiable release gates within the CI/CD pipeline before any code reaches production.

states.name: Operationally Resilient
states.description: The system demonstrates the ability to adjust its functioning prior to, during, or following an unexpected disturbance.

checklist.name: Blast Radius Determined
checklist.description: Failure Mode Analysis (FMA) is executed to systematically examine technical flows and determine the precise blast radius of degradations.

checklist.name: Resilience Potentials Mastered
checklist.description: The organization operationalizes the four interconnected abilities of resilience: Respond, Monitor, Anticipate, and Learn.

checklist.name: Faults Empirically Validated
checklist.description: Chaos Engineering actively injects faults into production or near-production environments to validate automated resilience mechanisms under duress.

alphas.name: Software Supply Chain Security
alphas.description: The formalized risk management strategy for entrusting application integrity to third-party and open-source components.

states.name: Prevented
states.description: Risky dependencies are blocked before they enter the developer environment.

checklist.name: Package Firewall Active
checklist.description: A package firewall is established to automatically block known vulnerable components.

states.name: Detected
states.description: Deep visibility is established into the application dependency tree.

checklist.name: Dynamic Visibility Gained
checklist.description: Continuous visibility into the dependency tree is achieved utilizing dynamic Software Bills of Materials (SBOMs).

states.name: Documented
states.description: A formal inventory of third-party code is strictly maintained.

checklist.name: Inventory Verifiable
checklist.description: A formal, verifiable inventory of all third-party code is securely maintained.

states.name: Remediated
states.description: Vulnerabilities are actively and automatically prioritized for fixing.

checklist.name: Exploitability Prioritized
checklist.description: The prioritization and remediation of discovered vulnerabilities is automated based on actual exploitability rather than theoretical risk.

workProducts.name: System-Theoretic Hazard Analysis
workProducts.description: The comprehensive documentation detailing the STPA control models and resulting safety constraints.

levelsOfDetail.name: Foundation Defined
levelsOfDetail.description: The boundaries of the analysis and unacceptable losses are defined.

checklist.name: Losses Documented
checklist.description: System-level unacceptable losses are fully documented.

checklist.name: Hazards Identified
checklist.description: System-level hazards leading to losses under worst-case environmental conditions are identified.

levelsOfDetail.name: Control Actions Evaluated
levelsOfDetail.description: The system is fully modeled and unsafe actions are translated into mitigation constraints.

checklist.name: HCS Diagrammed
checklist.description: The Hierarchical Control Structure is visually modeled.

checklist.name: UCAs Listed
checklist.description: Unsafe Control Actions are rigorously identified.

checklist.name: Mitigations Generated
checklist.description: Robust engineering mitigations and safety constraints are created from loss scenarios.

workProducts.name: Strategic Architecture Wardley Map
workProducts.description: A strategic framework artifact connecting business capabilities to competitive reality on an evolution axis.

levelsOfDetail.name: Value Chain Visualized
levelsOfDetail.description: User needs and components are mapped.

checklist.name: Components Plotted
checklist.description: Components are plotted across Genesis, Custom Built, Product/Rental, and Commodity phases.

levelsOfDetail.name: Sourcing Strategy Applied
levelsOfDetail.description: Build, Buy, and Reuse decisions are finalized.

checklist.name: Differentiation Built
checklist.description: Strategic, highly differentiated components are slated for custom in-house building.

checklist.name: Commodities Purchased
checklist.description: Standardized components are designated for SaaS or Vendor purchase.

workProducts.name: SRE Chaos Engineering Playbook
workProducts.description: The documented empirical testing plans for validating automated resilience mechanisms.

levelsOfDetail.name: Faults Designed
levelsOfDetail.description: Failure Mode Analysis is completed and specific faults are identified.

checklist.name: Blast Radius Modeled
checklist.description: The precise blast radius of potential degradations is systematically examined.

checklist.name: Experiments Authored
checklist.description: Experiments involving network partitions, CPU spikes, or datacenter losses are authored.

levelsOfDetail.name: Experiments Executed
levelsOfDetail.description: Faults are actively injected and results evaluated.

checklist.name: Dependencies Uncovered
checklist.description: Hidden dependencies and fragile architectural linkages are uncovered and documented.

checklist.name: Resilience Validated
checklist.description: The system's potential to respond is empirically validated under duress.

activities.name: Contextualize System Complexity
activities.description: Understand the specific operational context of the software systems using the Cynefin framework and Causal Loop Diagrams.

activities.name: Execute System-Theoretic Process Analysis (STPA)
activities.description: Perform proactive hazard analysis to identify systemic flaws and unknown unknowns in software interactions.

activities.name: Embed Risk into Agile Cadences
activities.description: Democratize risk management by integrating it directly into Sprint Planning, Daily Standups, Sprint Reviews, and Retrospectives.

activities.name: Validate Resilience with Chaos Engineering
activities.description: Actively inject faults into production environments to validate that automated resilience mechanisms function correctly.

patterns.name: Adaptive Technical Risk Lifecycle
patterns.description: An overarching sequence orchestrating the transition from complex system sense-making to empirical resilience validation.

patternViews.name: Contextualization & Architecture Phase
patternViews.description: Establishing situational awareness and strategic architectural models.

patternViews.name: Proactive Hazard Modeling Phase
patternViews.description: Applying STPA methodologies to complex interactions.

patternViews.name: Continuous Delivery Mitigation Phase
patternViews.description: Embedding constraints directly into Agile ceremonies and CI/CD pipelines.

patternViews.name: Empirical Resilience Phase
patternViews.description: Testing the system's ability to heal and respond in production.

workBreakdowns.name: Perform System-Theoretic Process Analysis Execution
workBreakdowns.description: The detailed execution stream for modeling dynamic control problems.

task.name: Define Unacceptable System Losses
task.description: Identify critical losses and boundaries for the system analysis.

task.name: Build Hierarchical Control Structure
task.description: Detail controllers, actuators, and sensors in a holistic model.

task.name: Identify Unsafe Control Actions
task.description: Analyze constraints and UCA vulnerabilities within the structural model.

workBreakdowns.name: Implement Chaos Engineering Operation
workBreakdowns.description: The execution stream for actively injecting faults to prove empirical resilience.

complexity.name: Chaos Operations Complexity
complexity.description: Complexity evaluation for production chaos testing.

task.description: Systematically examine technical flows to determine blast radius.

task.name: Inject Targeted Production Faults
task.description: Execute chaos experiments such as simulated datacenter loss.
